It, namely the द्विगु or द्वन्द compound, with regard to which singular number has been ordained by the above rules, is always neuter gender.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

The स् of the first person is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

Terms: लेट्

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'he is their leader' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case with the force of Genitive 6th-Case.

Terms: कन्

Before the Imperative affix हि , शा is substituted for शास्।

Terms: अभीय Rules
